svg.title: Stack, heap, and the pointer that outlived its frame
svg.desc: Three stack frames drawn as boxes on the left and a heap allocation on the right. A green arrow shows make_buf returning a pointer; the make_buf frame is then crossed out in red, and a red arrow shows the caller still holding the address of memory whose owning frame is gone.
svg.text: Stack, heap, and the pointer that outlived its frame
The NAME for it did - and
nothing will ever free it. Both
halves of that sentence are a
who calls free()? the caller. Write it in the
docstring or it will not happen.
